answer: To secure our decentralized nebula of autonomous peers, a validation bridge links hardware cryptographic attestation chains with zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. Rather than allow rogue identities to wander unchecked, joining network consensus requires bonding stake that scales as a superlinear function, O(N^1.5), of cluster density. This imposes exponential capital exhaustion on any coordinated Sybil swarm trying to forge validity.
